text: Honey never spoils. Archaeologists have found three thousand year old honey in Egyptian tombs that is still perfectly edible.
Octopuses have three hearts. Two pump blood to the gills, while the third pumps it to the rest of the body.
Bananas are botanically classified as berries, but strawberries are not. Strawberries are actually an aggregate fruit.
Sharks are older than trees. Sharks appeared around four hundred million years ago, while trees appeared about three hundred fifty million years ago.
The Eiffel Tower can grow more than six inches taller during the summer, because the iron expands in the heat.
Wombats produce cube shaped poop. Scientists believe it stops the droppings from rolling away and helps them mark territory.
Venus is the hottest planet in our solar system, even though Mercury is closer to the Sun, because of its thick greenhouse gas atmosphere.
The human nose can detect over one trillion distinct scents, far more than scientists once believed was possible.
The Great Wall of China is not actually visible from space with the naked eye, despite the popular myth.
Tardigrades, also called water bears, can survive the vacuum of outer space, extreme radiation, and being frozen for decades.
